1/1.lead: Costed activities show a combined spending shortfall of Rs 51.96 crore against plans, and the gap is spread across blocks rather than being confined to one location.
1/1.detail: The broad spread appears in 27 of 28 asset categories; Banking Facilities shows no clear pattern. Rangeilunda has the largest recorded gap at Rs 9.11 crore, with Rs 2.73 crore spent against Rs 11.84 crore planned, while Kalimela spent Rs 1.76 crore of Rs 7.65 crore. Blocks should review ageing activities and reconcile whether these gaps reflect works yet to start, incomplete expenditure records or plans that are no longer active; the sample does not by itself establish the cause.
